rules.universe: fixed existing Nifty Total Market mirrored 751 exact symbol+series; only symbols current through latest completed session included; no aliases substituted
rules.entry: signal close > max(high[t-20:t]); next available session open entry only if flat
rules.exit: signal close < min(low[t-10:t]); next available session open exit only if long
rules.entry_warmup: 20 preceding observed bars required; current bar excluded from both channels
rules.end_of_data: open positions marked separately, no forced liquidation; last-close entry orders pending, not counted as trades
rules.costs: gross returns, zero brokerage/taxes/slippage/spread; no sizing/capital constraints
rules.max_drawdown: portfolio maxDD unavailable: no sizing or mark-to-market portfolio model. Not replaced by misleading pooled trade drawdown.
rules.calendar: bars are observed per-symbol sessions; missing observations can distort channel windows
limitations: fixed present-day universe causes survivorship bias
corporate-action and adjustment consistency in mixed Turso sources not independently verified
missing/invalid/stale symbols excluded; no history splices or renamed-symbol mappings
no next-session open after 6 Nov available; latest fresh signals are unfilled

caveats: Historical closed-trade arithmetic statistics, not portfolio returns. Open trades excluded. No equal-capital sizing, compounding, equity curve, CAGR, or portfolio drawdown.
Gross zero costs; present-day universe survivorship bias; mixed-source corporate-action adjustments and missing sessions remain unverified. Extreme returns are data-sensitive, not recommendations.

Two zero-OHLC bars on 18 Jun 2026 (BAJAJ-AUTO and NAM-INDIA) were excluded only in Strategy 7. Earlier six reports remain unchanged. Strategy 3 includes an invalid BAJAJ-AUTO zero-price exit (−100%). Historical comparison is provisional.
Overlap membership uses all entry-condition qualifiers, including already-held stocks; not all fresh orders. No stock qualifies in 4, 5, 6 or 7 strategies.
Year/month statistics group closed trades by exit date; no closed observations means unavailable, not zero. Overlapping trades are not independent.
